title: DevBox vault
description: Decrypted content of the vault file ~/.local/share/devbox/vault.age, used when no Secret Service is available. The file is only ever stored age-encrypted, never as plain JSON.

$schema.description: URL of the schema this file follows.

entries.description: Secrets keyed by the reference without backend prefix (age:<name> in credentials.json refers to <name>).

secret.description: The secret, e.g. a token, password or passphrase.

expiresAt.description: When the secret expires; null if it does not expire or the date is unknown.
